templates.description: Atmospheric forcing and physical hazard pass-through into downstream weather severity and damage indicators.
Positive El Nino Southern Oscillation anomalies weaken monsoon precipitation over tropical basins with multi-month lag.
Sustained soil-moisture deficit crosses crop stress threshold, depressing staple grain yield and livestock carrying capacity.
Compound extreme precipitation over already-saturated watersheds incapacitates road, rail, and power transmission corridors.
Irrigation storage, flood levees, and grid hardening attenuate marginal physical hazard transmission into economic output loss.
